tools.name: search_homes
tools.description: Search Hungarian nursing homes (idősek otthona) and temporary care homes (gondozóház) from the official social-care register. Filter by city, county, type, operator type or name.

tools.name: get_home
tools.description: Full register data for one nursing home by id: operator, places (incl. premium), care types, contact and prices where published.

tools.name: compare_homes
tools.description: Side-by-side comparison of 2–5 nursing homes by id.

tools.name: list_cities
tools.description: Hungarian towns with nursing homes, home counts and number of places.

tools.name: send_enquiry
tools.description: Send the user's enquiry about a place (férőhely) to 1–3 nursing homes so they contact the user. ONLY call this when the user has explicitly asked for it and agreed that their name and contact details are shared with the selected homes; set userConsent=true only in that case.
